policy: Record /landing/camera/image_raw only when the selected pad campaign next_index is zero. Snapshot the topic selection on ARM and retain it until DISARM. First-route retries retain raw; other pads start with their own queue. Base evidence and webcam recording remain enabled on every route.
unavailable_status_policy: Include diagnostic raw if route status is missing, malformed or older than 2s; log that fallback. Normal selected-route flights publish fresh status before ARM.
implementation: Generic conditional recording groups in flight_safety; ArUco topic, field and index are supplied by stack configuration. Shared code contains no ArUco-specific policy.

live_deployment.method: Clean committed Git revisions only; owner and module lock updated, snapshot synchronized without bypassing dirty guards.
live_deployment.restart: Temporary recorder-only check followed by normal safety launcher restart while disarmed POSCTL. Perception, planner and trajectory queue retained.

postflight_latency_evidence.scope: Three preceding full-raw flights. ML file ctime approximates transfer completion, before subsequent checksum/readiness checks.
postflight_latency_evidence.camera: Real frame stalls also occurred during the postflight interval. Transfer workload coincides with them; causation is not established. Camera node reported three cumulative stream restart attempts; camera recovery code was not changed.
postflight_latency_evidence.readiness: JSON sync proof is valid for 6 seconds. Repeated latest-large-bag verification can leave stale intervals. LED blue/white means preparing; fixed ready color corresponds to a fresh ready mission hint.

remaining_validation: Next real flight must confirm the smaller bag and postflight delay reduction. This change does not claim to fix the USB camera stall mechanism.
